newsitem.title: USA: Metrocall stake held by UBS Capital LLC.
newsitem.headline: Metrocall stake held by UBS Capital LLC.

text.p: UBS Capital LLC said it holds a 6.04 percent stake in Metrocall Inc or 1,544,019 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, UBS said of the total common shares, it bought an aggregate 455,365 common shares between December 12 and December 23 at prices ranging from $4.50 to $4.88 per share.

UBS also purchased warrants to buy 1,088,654 common, as part of units containing one share of Series A convertible Preferred Stock and one warrant to purchase 18.266 common shares at an exercise price per share of $7.40.
The warrants are exercisable at any time through and including November 15, 2001. The preferred shares are convertible into common shares starting on November 15, 2001.
UBS said it bought the common shares and warrants for investment purposes. It also has the right to appoint one of the eleven members of Metrocall's Board of Directors.
UBS Securities LLC owns a 99 percent stake in UBS Capital LLC. Union Bank of Switzerland owns a 95 percent stake in UBS Securities.
Metrocall of Alexandria, Va., provides paging and wireless messaging services to over 1.3 million subscribers in all 50 states.
